DECISION: reach-target-corrected-outcome-decision-20261024
Author: the overseer, acting under the operator's October13 delegation.

Accept the corrected paired result. The overseer read corrected_reading_result.json: all8gatesPASS, candidate offered8/selected4; read independent reviewREADY. Preserve originalFAIL and supplemental provenance. Keep the candidate implementation as a tested experimental option, default off: there is measured benefit to retain, and a regression to resolve before production adoption. Both complete learned states remain preserved; neither is promoted. No training, model loading, physics, new replay or r2 launch.

Authorize the proposed H1/H2 reading as ONE combined saved-array analysis, not two experiments. At most90seconds executable work within the current900second total (620.644 used,279.356 remaining before new work). Use existing captures/reader outputs only. No new framework, full suite or another reading of unchanged pairing gates. One compact table for all16hands, with OFF/ON side by side: starting position, raw candidate target, actually scored/executed wrist request, forecast endpoint and actual250ms endpoint; distances to target and executed request; projected movement along start-to-request where that vector is nonzero; perpendicular residual. Name world frame/units and selected/rejected status. Preserve the denominator16hands/all8bodies versus8hands/4selected bodies. Missing arrays are missing, not reconstructed from a different step.

Clarify causality: blending placing body5's executed request9.38cm from the target is established arithmetic, not a hypothesis. Whether reducing blending would improve the real movement is NOT settled. Forecast1.75cm versus actual7.41cm is a measured prediction error. A forecast need not move directly toward a requested point under contacts/inertia; projected direction alone does not prove a coding fault. The arm-floor contact and elbow movement support a mechanism to examine, not proof that the floor caused the miss. Do not call a joint-limit cause when none reached its limit.

Question the table must answer: is the remaining miss mainly already present in the executed request, or does the predictor also misestimate the motion resulting from that request across the selected cases? Multiple mechanisms may coexist. A static world snapshot from the existing restore readback can be used if already saved as values; no MuJoCo/model load for missing joint trajectories in this authorization. Return one evidence-backed next repair/comparison proposal with exact code path, unchanged conditions, measurable success/regression limits and measured execution cost basis. Do not change smoothing or ranking automatically from this table. If the saved data cannot discriminate causes, name the precise missing signal; do not expand into another open-ended analysis series.

Status/page wording: direct target choice improved7of8selected hands versus the old planner; only5of8moved closer than their own starts; one selected hand was worse than OFF; no hand finished within2cm at250ms. Whole-pose score improvement is not a substitute for hand reaching. Finish the existing section7 update/review/browser check and link corrected evidence; no additional standalone report. The one-second hold criterion remains the ability target, not a result of this short window.

Closeout corrections accepted as explanations with provenance: shared scene differences are process-specific include paths to byte-identical models; caregiver status differences are named metadata; timestamp changes have unchanged hashes and no asserted cause. Keep actual recorded findings, do not erase them. All new executable analysis/validation/file checks count toward the remaining allowance, including previously untimed work using conservative bounds; ordinary reading of messages is not a new experiment. No cleanup authority added.

Send the combined table's conclusion, next concrete proposal and completed page receipt together. No acknowledgement-only round required.
